title: The Bargain Pit
text: A ring of smooth stone round a pit that breathes warm air, in and out, slow as a sleeper. Coins glitter on the lip where someone lost their nerve. Carved on the rim, in a hand like a child's: anything thrown in comes back as something better.

options.label: Throw a purse of gold into its breath.

outcomes.text: It comes back up on a warm gust, a heavier purse, the coins slick and faintly warm.
It does not come back. Far below, something swallows.

options.label: The hardiest bleeds into the pit.

outcomes.text: It comes back as something in the veins that was not there before, strong and hot and not entirely theirs.

options.label: Roll a stone over its mouth.

outcomes.text: The breathing stops. Somewhere a long way down, something is very disappointed in you.
